cards.scope: Build additive ICP escrow accounting and backend API for ckSOL mint attempts
cards.evidenceText: PR #610 remains draft and is refreshed onto current main 2a71ec64. The rent-only/dust preflight defect was reproduced: positive SOL below the minter minimum exposed the address with ICP and cycles unavailable. The predicate now requires either a minimum deposit already present or processing payment readiness; the focused regression failed before and passes after the fix, alongside existing full-deposit and insufficient-ICP cases. Previous frontend and Stability Pool checks passed on the prior head; use the PR checks panel for the updated head. Backend lifecycle source and Candid are unchanged from the previously validated source head. No production action occurred; reserve remains zero/off. Direct running-upgrade traps remain reproduced; tested stop/drain is the interim mitigation, but other deployment paths are not enforced.
